title: Skill
description: skill.yaml in skills/<domain>/<skill-id>/ (PRD 8.2). The planner sees only id and the one-line description; the executing agent loads the full skill.

reviewer.description: The domain expert who signed the skill off.

description.description: One line, shown to the planner.

tool_access.description: FR-ACC-02 (1.1.0, ADR-0027): the level this skill may use each listed connector at, keyed by connector id (config/connectors.yaml or config/mcp.yaml). It can only lower the team's level for that connector: the level in force is the lower of the two (tilo_policy.access_levels.effective_level), so act here sets no further limit and no value can raise the team's. A connector left out uses the team's level. Optional: a skill without it changes nothing. It is part of the signed-off, version-pinned skill (PRD 8.2), so changing it is a new skill version.

embedded_schema.description: A JSON Schema (2020-12) for the skill's inputs or outputs. Deliberately open: the skill loader checks it against the 2020-12 meta-schema.
